faq_h2: Meadows Del Mar Homes: Common Questions

faq.q: How much do homes in Meadows Del Mar cost?
faq.a: In the last 12 months, 3 single-family homes in Meadows Del Mar sold between $3.63M and $4.75M, at a median of $4.28M. See the price-by-size cards and recent sales on this page for what each kind of home sold for.

faq.q: How many homes are in Meadows Del Mar?
faq.a: Meadows Del Mar has about 200 homes, built 2000 to 2017.

faq.q: What school area is Meadows Del Mar in?
faq.a: Meadows Del Mar is in the Sage Canyon Elementary attendance area (Del Mar Union School District). High school is Torrey Pines High (San Dieguito Union HSD), with Canyon Crest Academy and San Dieguito Academy available by lottery. School boundaries change, so confirm any address with the district before you buy.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell in Meadows Del Mar?
faq.a: Over the last 12 months, the median Meadows Del Mar home sold in 38 days on market. Well-priced homes often go under contract in the first week.
